hero.title: My approach
hero.text: I design and develop high-performing, maintainable web solutions tailored to the real needs of each project.

identity.title: A developer who thinks beyond the code
identity.paragraph1: I am Lucas Yvernaux, a full-stack web developer with more than four years of experience. I work on web projects with a particular focus on front-end development, user experience and technical quality.
identity.paragraph2: My role is not simply to turn a design into an interface. I aim to understand the underlying needs, anticipate constraints and build solutions that remain reliable, scalable and understandable over time.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: A clear architecture makes future changes, debugging and collaboration easier. I favour clearly defined responsibilities and simple solutions whenever they are sufficient.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Code should meet today's requirements without compromising future evolution. I pay particular attention to maintainability, consistency and robustness.

security.title: Security
security.text: Security should be considered from the beginning. Input validation, access control, data protection and attack-surface reduction are part of the development process.

expertise.title: Building solid solutions
expertise.intro: Every project has its own constraints. My approach is to choose tools and architecture according to the actual requirements rather than unnecessarily increasing the technology stack.

customDevelopment.title: Custom development
customDevelopment.text: Building interfaces and features tailored to the specific requirements of each project.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.text: Designing modular and scalable structures with clear boundaries that can support the growth of a project.

security.title: Security
security.text: Considering application risks and security best practices throughout the development lifecycle.

performance.title: Performance
performance.text: Optimising rendering, resources and user journeys to maintain a fast and fluid experience.

maintenance.title: Maintainability
maintenance.text: Structuring code and components to make fixes, future changes and reuse easier.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: Identify objectives, users, technical constraints and priorities before choosing a solution.

design.title: Design
design.text: Define a coherent architecture and user experience based on the identified requirements.

build.title: Build
build.text: Progressively develop a testable, secure and performant solution that remains flexible enough to evolve.
